findings.detail: '0 mantiene la hora de contacto diaria local.' stacks two adjectives after the noun; 'local' can be read as qualifying 'contacto' rather than the clock the time is kept in, which is the distinction the sidecar calls out (whole elapsed hours, not wall-clock). Meaning is recoverable and nothing is promised wrongly.
findings.remediation: 0 mantiene la hora de contacto diaria en hora local.
